definition.zh-TW: 研究發展費用占營業收入的比例，看公司把多少生意的錢投回研發。數值越高表示越重視研發，常見於科技業。
definition.en: Research and development expense as a share of revenue: how much of the business is ploughed back into R&D. Higher means a stronger research focus, typical of technology companies.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
